user_id.description: The app user_id (auth User.id) this subscription belongs to

user_name.description: Display name of the user this subscription belongs to (denormalized from AppUser for easy identification)

endpoint.description: Push service endpoint URL (web push) or fcm://{token} (native FCM)

p256dh_key.description: The p256dh public key from the PushSubscription.keys object (omitted for FCM/native subscriptions — Web Push only)

auth_key.description: The auth secret from the PushSubscription.keys object (omitted for FCM/native subscriptions — Web Push only)

device_identifier.description: Links this subscription to its device's per-device notification settings in UserSettings.device_settings_profiles

user_agent.description: Browser/device user agent string at time of subscription

last_used_at.description: Timestamp of the last successful push sent
